verdicts.title: Analysis of multiset dimension in fuzzy zero-divisor graphs associated with commutative rings
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The article provides a thorough analysis of the concept of multiset dimension in fuzzy graphs of zero divisors that model the internal structure of commutative rings.
